tei:div.tei:p: "!#༄༅: slob dpon padmas mdzad pa'i rgyud sde bzhi'i yang snying: bde gshegs zhi khro'i snying khrag gcig tu bsdus pa mtshon srung rdo rje'i go khrab kun thub srung ba'i rgyal po'i bri rgyun zab pa'i mthar thug bzhugs so:

ྈྈྈྈྈྈ sprul pa'i sku ste sku yi mchog: 'gro ba'i mgon po bla na med: yid bzhin nor bu re skong ba: rdo rje thod phreng rtsal la 'dud: slob dpon chen po padma 'byung gnas dang: 'khor los sgyur rgyal khri srong lde btsan dang: sprul pa'i mkha' 'gro ye shes mtsho rgyal dang: legs pa'i dpal 'dzin 'bro bza' byang chub dang: bsod nams bsags pa'i pho yong rgyal btsun dang: sbyangs pa'i stobs ldan bai ro tsa na dang: tshul khrims ldan pa nam mkha'i snying po dang: brtul zhugs ldan pa ka ba dpal rtsegs dang: bsod nams ldan pa klu yi rgyal mtshan dang: padma la gus dge slong rin mchog dang: 'bri yig mgyogs pa ldan ma rtse mang dang: gus par 'bri ba a tsar ye snang dang: sgra dbyangs mgyogs pa bdun pa rgyal mchog dang: rigs rgyud ldan pa mu tig btsan po dang: bsod nams stobs ldan mu tig khri lde dang: blo gros 'dzin pa bsod nams shes rab dang: dpa' rtsal stobs ldan rdo rje sprel chung dang: yig tshang legs 'dzin khri rje yab lhag dang: don kun grub pa'i ye shes rgyal po sogs: bsod nams bsags pa'i bod 'bangs mang po dang: dkar po'i phyogs kyi lha klu bsam 'das pas: brag dmar dpal gyi bsam yas lhun grub tu: gser g.yu mu tig dngul zangs rin chen khri: dar zab man tri yid 'ong mdzes pa'i gdan: za 'og gur phub 'ja' ltar bkra ba ru: yid bzhin nor bu padma 'byung gnas bzhugs: ye shes mkha' 'gro de yi mdun du bzhugs: mnga' bdag rgyal po mdun du gus pas gnas: sgra bsgyur lo tsā g.yas rol mgo nas 'dug: gser dngul mu men maṇḍal g.yu yis brgyan: phyi nang mchod pa mdangs ldan yid 'ong dang: gzi mchong nal skyogs rgun 'brum 'bras la sogs: bdud rtsis legs bkang gu ru rje la drangs: phyag 'tshal gsol btab bsang ba dpag med byas: rtse gcig mos pas gser sogs me tog 'thor: lha klu kun gyis me tog char pa dang:

sgra 'od 'ja' gur yid tsam sa yang g.yos: dus der lhun grub dpal gyi bsam yas su: phyi nang theg pa mchog gi rim pa dang: khyad par yongs rdzogs rta mgrin rgyud rnams dang: rdzogs chen gser zhun zhal gdams brgya rtsa gsungs: rgyal blon 'khor bcas lha klu la sogs kun: tshe 'di nyid la bde ba can du phyin: bya ba byed med 'gro don lhun gyis grub: ci bsam ma lus don kun dus der 'grub: rje 'bangs mgrin gcig 'dun pa drag po yis: mchod pa phul nas rje la 'di skad zhus: bdag cag 'dir 'dus don chen bsam pa 'grub: bdag gi bod khams ma rungs blun po'i yul: kha ba can 'dir dus phyis ci 'dra mchis: dus gsum mkhyen pa padma rgyal po yis: 'gro la brtser dgongs bdag la gsung par zhu: zhes gu ru la zhus pa: ྈྈྈྈྈ gu rus gsungs pa: rgyal po la sogs bod 'bangs rnams legs par nyon la yid la zhog cig: da ste lo bzhi bcu zhe gcig nas 'di ltar rim pa bzhin 'byung bar 'gyur ro: zhes ma 'ongs lung bstan skabs bcu drug pa gsungs pas bod kyi rgyal blon thams cad shin tu sha g.ya' bar gyur to: der bod kyi rgyal blon thams cad blo dang 'dun pa gcig pas de lta bu'i dus byung tsa na 'gro ba bzhi cha grir 'gum par gda' bas: grir mi 'gum la gris mi tshugs pa'i gdams pa gcig gu ru rje la zhus pa legs so: zhes kha 'chams te mchod pa phul nas mgrin gcig tu zhus pa: e ma 'gro mgon padma 'byung: ma 'ongs snyigs ma'i dus de ru: rang lus rdo rje ltar 'gyur zhing: bar chad rkyen gyis mi tshugs pa'i: yid bzhin nor bu lta bu yi: khyad par 'phags pa'i gdams ngag gcig: gsang ba thugs kyi dkyil 'khor nas: gab pa'i gdams pa mngon phyung ste: 'gro la brtser dgongs bshad du gsol: zhes zhus pas: gu rus 'di skad ces bka' bstsal to: dus der dgongs pa'i gdams ngag gcig: rgyud sde kun gyi bcud phyung zhing:

padma nga yi snying lta bu: gdams pa'i rgyal po mtshon srung 'di: phyi rabs don du bshad par bya: 'dzam gling nor bus gang ba bas: gdams pa 'di ka yid la chongs: snying gi dkyil du sa ma ya: sems la chongs shig tiṣṭha lhan: zhes gsungs nas: mtshon srung ba'i gdams pa 'di gsungs so: mtshon srung gi lo rgyus rdzogs so: sa ma ya: ྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ rgya rgya rgya: ྈྈྈ ྈྈྈྈྈྈ ྈྈྈ ༈ rgya gar skad du: tikṣa rakṣa sarba tsakra u pa de sha nā ma: bod skad du: mtshon cha thams cad srung bar byed pa 'khor lo'i man ngag ces bya ba: bcom ldan 'das zhi khro rab 'byams kyi tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo: thabs mkhas thugs rje chos dbyings dag pa la: longs spyod rdzogs dang sprul sku'i 'od zer 'bar: myur mgyogs thugs rjes sdug bsngal tshogs skyob pa'i: rgyal sras sems dpar bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod: 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho sdug bsngal 'khrigs pa las: rtag par des gtses 'dug pa'i 'gro ba la: mi 'jigs mgon dang bde ldan dpung gyur pa'i: sra brtan mi 'gyur mtshon srung bstan par bya: phyogs bcu'i rgyal ba sras bcas ma lus pa'i: sku yi byin rlabs gzi brjid ma lus pa: gcig tu dril ba'i mtshon srung 'di la ni: thog mar rnal 'byor dam tshig sdom par ldan: snying rje shes rab brtson 'grus ldan pa yis: 'du 'dzi spangs pa'i dben gnas yid 'thad par: mchod gtor brgyan bsham bdag nyid gang mos pa'i: lha yi bsnyen pa rim bzhin thems par bya: de nas dus dang skar ma bzang po rgyal la sogs/ la: byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed rab ldan pas: bde gshegs kun 'dus mtshon srung bri bar bya: mthing shog yul snyoms gru bzhi legs pa la: dbus btsal gser gyi thur mas mig phug la: sa bcu mtshon byed 'khor lo rim bcu bskor: tha mar me ri rdo rje tsha tsha bcas: gru bzhi sprul pa'i 'khor lo mchod rten bkod: 1) 'khor lo'i lte bar lte ba mthing kha/

thugs kyi rigs 'dus pa: rdo rje'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bar dgod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra ma hā sarba pheṃ pheṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: oṃ badzra pā ṇi kā la baṃ sarba tīkṣ+ṇa sa ma ya: hrī hrī hrī: tadya thā: oṃ mu ni mu ni ma hā mu na ye swā hā: oṃ tīkṣ+ṇa lu ni ta ka ta ka ta ka: oṃ hrī ha yaṃ grī ba phaṭa: mtshon gtub sod mā ra ya phaṭa: 'chang ba la mtshon cha'i 'jigs pa thams cad srungs shig rakṣaḥrakṣaḥrakṣa: 2) phyi rim mu khyud dmar po/ la: thugs kyi lha mo'i rig pa 'di: sngags 'go phyir bstan 'god par bya: oṃ badzra kro tī shwa rī ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐: oṃ ha ri ni sa hūm̐ phaṭa: oṃ badzra ma hā sarba padma kro tī shwa rī hūm̐ phaṭa: mtshon bcad do gtub bo: 'chang ba po la mtshon cha'i gnod pa thams cad srungs shig rakṣa: 3) mu khyud de'i phyi ma la: sku yi 'khor lo dkar po/ rtsibs bcu bri: rtsibs la 'di ltar sngags rnams 'god: mgo phyir bstan/ oṃ hūm̐ badzra kā ra sa ma ya duṣṭān ma hā hrī du pa la ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ming 'di la mtshon gyi 'jigs pa srungs shig rakṣa: oṃ hūm̐ badzra bhighnān du sha ya sa ma ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hrī phaṭa: ming 'di la= oṃ hūm̐ badzra sa ma ya spho ṭa yaṃ spho ṭa yaṃ hūm̐ ha ha phaṭa: ming 'di la= oṃ hūm̐ badzra tīkṣ+ṇa ya sarba hriṃ ḍa hriṃ ḍa phaṭa: ming 'di la= oṃ hūm̐ badzra pa ta ya: ya spho ṭa badzra sa ma ya badzra phaṭa: ming 'di la= oṃ hūm̐ badzra ya mānta badzra kro ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa: ming 'di la= oṃ hūm̐ badzra tīkṣ+ṇa tīkṣ+ṇa sarba sa ma ya hrīng hrīng ha ha hūm̐ phaṭa: ming 'di la= oṃ hūm̐ badzra gṛhṇa badzra pre bhi sha ya phaṭa hūm̐ hūm̐ hrī ma hāṃ ka ru ga na hūm̐ phaṭa: ming 'di la= oṃ hūm̐ badzra dhri kā ba du ma sa ya mā ra ta ka ya he haṃ haṃ hūm̐ phaṭa: ming 'di la= oṃ hūm̐ badzra badzra a mṛta kunḍa lī sa ma ya ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa:

ming 'di la= rtsibs mchan bcu ser po/ la mtshon cha yi: ngar bcag pa'i sngags 'di ni: mgo phyir bstan la dgod pa'o: oṃ rnor zlog chom dril spha ra ṇa bhyo zlog: oṃ rnor sod chom zlog spha ra ṇa bhyo zlog: oṃ rnor chum mtshon dril spha ra ṇa bhyo zlog: oṃ rnor sgyur chom sod dril spha ra ṇa bhyo zlog: oṃ rnor gtubs chom nan spha ra ṇa bhyo zlog: oṃ rnor shig chom sgyur spha ra ṇa bhyo zlog: oṃ rnor nan chom nan chom sbud spha ra ṇa bhyo zlog: oṃ rnor sbud chom shig spha ra ṇa bhyo zlog: oṃ rnor phyung chom shig spha ra ṇa bhyo zlog: oṃ rnor zlog sgyur chom sgyur spha ra ṇa bhyo zlog: 4) mu khyud de'i phyi ma dmar po/ la: yig 'go nang bstan dmar po la: mtshon gyi bskal pa bshigs pa yi: ye shes chen po'i sngags 'di dgod: na mo ratna tra yā ya: oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrī: ka kha ga gha nga: tsa tsha dza dzha nya: ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa: ta tha da dha na: pa pha ba bha ma: ya ra la wa sha ṣa sa ha kṣa: a ā: i ī: u ū: ṛ ṝ: l̥ l̥̄: e ai: o au: aṃ a: oṃ na ma sa manta badzrā ṇāṃ: hūm̐ ya ma sha ri sa ma ya: mtshon cha gṛhṇa da ha da ha sarba padma he ru ka sa ma ya: mtshon cha gtub gtub mā ra ya zlog rbad rbad rbud ya: oṃ ka la duṣṭān ma ma ka tra ka tra bhyo bhyo zlog zlog: oṃ e waṃ sa ma ya mi li mi li su hūm̐ bhandha bhandha phaṭa: ma hā kha sho ya tri hūm̐ tri hūm̐ hūm̐: ming 'di zhes bya ba la mtshon gyi 'jigs pa thams cad srungs shig zlog cig rakṣa: rakṣa: 5) mu khyud de'i phyi ma ljang khu la/ la: drag po'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad bri: de la sra brtan sngags 'di dgod: oṃ sarba kro ta ni kā la du dun badzra badzra hūm̐: ming 'di la 'khor lo ltar bskor ba'i mtshon cha srungs shig rakṣa: oṃ sarba bhi tsa ya a pra ti ha ta badzra badzra hūm̐: ming 'di la me ltar sreg pa'i mtshon= oṃ bhuddha sha ya ha sa kī li kī la badzra badzra hūm̐:

ming 'di la gsor ltar 'bugs pa'i mtshon= oṃ ha ya mu ma de du sa na hūm̐ phaṭa badzra badzra hūm̐: ming 'di la ri ltar gnon pa'i mtshon= oṃ druṃ bhandha bhandha ha la tīkṣ+ṇa tīkṣ+ṇa badzra badzra hūm̐: ming 'di la lcags sgrog ltar 'ching ba'i mtshon= oṃ dha ma dha ma ri ha sa na sha na phaṭa phaṭa badzra badzra hūm̐: ming 'di la thog ltar mgyogs pa'i mtshon= oṃ ni dzha la raṃ raṃ si ghe laṃ st+waṃ bha badzra badzra hūm̐: ming 'di la kha char ltar 'bab pa'i mtshon= oṃ badzra suṃ bhrūm̐ padma hrī ti badzra badzra hūm̐: ming 'di la rlung ltar g.yo ba'i mtshon cha srungs shig rakṣa: 'khor lo de yi rtsibs mchan la: mtshon gyi ngar bshig sngags 'di 'god: oṃ badzra tsag dus sha sarba rbad duṃ lha ma lhaṃ ltaṃ zer ba'ang 'dug/ mtshon cha mā ra ya sod sod: oṃ badzra ma hā ka tsa pa ye rbud rbud tser tser mtshon cha sarba zlog zlog: oṃ badzra kla du she bha ri shig shig ya ha mtshon cha sarba gtubs gtub: oṃ badzra du na ghri hā tākṣi hūm̐ phaṭa mtshon cha sarba rbud rbud: oṃ badzra ma ṇi pa traṃ ya ma du raṃ trig shag mtshon cha sarba sgyur sgyur/ oṃ badzra kṣo pur tir thā mā ka bi ta hūm̐ mtshon cha sarba byer byer: oṃ badzra hu me hūm̐ hrī sarba ghri ti ṭa m-i ṇi phaṭa: mtshon cha thams cad a ba dengs dengs: oṃ badzra ghu ha tiṣṭha saṃ bha raṃ du raṃ tshal pa ya mtshon cha sarba sa ma ya bhyo zlog: 6) mu khyud de'i phyi rim ser po/ la: dus min 'chi ba brgyad zlog pa'i: rig pa'i sngags 'di bkod par bya: tadya thā: na mo shākya rā dzā ya oṃ sarba saṃska ri buddha ta thā ga ta sarba pheṃ pheṃ: na mo bha ga te a pa ri mi tāyurdzñā na puṇye puṇye su bi nishtsi ta te dzo rā dzā ya ma hā sarba puṇye puṇye ta thā ga tā ya tadya thā puṣṭīṃ sarba pā shaṃ ku ru ye sarba siddhirtha puṇye oṃ sarba saṃska ri pa ri shuddha dharma te ga ga na sa mutga te sarba ro pa tsitta ma ni hūm̐ sarba bi shuddhe u pa gu ṇi puṇye puṇye sarba ro pa tsi ta swā hā:

ma hā nā ya pa ri dharma dhā tu ma hā pha la badzra ha se ha se swā hā: ming 'di zhes bya ba la dus ma yin pa'i 'chi ba dang mtshon cha'i 'jigs pa thams cad srungs shig rakṣaḥrakṣaḥrakṣa: 7) mu khyud de yi phyi ma sna tshogs/ la: mtshon chas mtshon cha zlog byed pa'i: ye shes rno myur mtshon cha bri: rdo rje rtse lnga lte ba la: rwa dang lte ba hūm̐ phyir bstan/ bcas dang: mda' gzhu 'gengs dang ral gri yi: nang du shā traṃ ba shaṃ zer ba'ang snang*/ bris pa dang: 'khor lo zhags pa la sogs lcags sgrog gi: lte ba rtsibs logs phaṭa hrī bri: rtse gsum rgyal mtshan lcags kyu yi: logs la ma makṣa gnas pa dang: rgyal mtshan zhing dbyug dgra st+wa la: thūṃ hrī muṃ hūm̐ zhes pa dang: me dang spu gri gtun shing la: phaṭa phaṭa nan nan zhes pa dang: gri so gcig pa ba dan dang: dbyug to khram shing logs dag la: bhyo bhyo rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ zhes dang: thog dang ri rab gri gug la: sa dun sha badzra nan: brag ri mchod rten sbrul zhags la: du du ma ma ki li kī li hūm̐: chu dang padma thod khrag la: oṃ du ma padma phaṭa: oṃ du hrī padma badzra phaṭa phaṭa:zer ba'ang snang*/ bum pa dpag bsam nor bu la: sha kra kṣa ya zhes pa da nga: tri shul phub dang rlung nag la: phaṭa phaṭa hrī hrī badzra dang: utpal dung rtsang kha ṭwāṃ ga: hūm̐ kṣa badzra rakṣa'o: kun gyi bar du sngags 'di dgod: oṃ āḥhūm̐ ya ma hā sarba rnor sod chom dril mtshon cha zlog: 8) mu khyud de yi phyi ma dmar po/ la: rdo rje go cha'i sngags 'di bri: mgo nang bstan/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hrīḥsarba badzra du na sha ya hūm̐ phaṭa: badzra mi ti mi ti ha ra ha ra hūm̐ phaṭa: dha ra ya dha ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa: tstshinda tstshinda hūm̐ phaṭa: ṣṭoṃ bhandha bhandha hūm̐ phaṭa: mā ra ya mā ra ya badzra pa kra pa kra badzra du naṃ badzra/ bhindha ya ma hūm̐ phaṭa: tadya thā: hūm̐ hrī mi ri ri ri ri: hūm̐ badzra sarba sha truṃ nan:

ka ra ka ra ka ra ka ra: spho ṭa sa ma hri: dha dha dha dha: sa ma ya: badzra badzra badzra badzra badzra badzra: rakṣa rakṣa: hūm̐ hūm̐ badzra nan hūm̐ hūm̐ ya ma badzra du na badzra kṣoṃ tra: tadya thā: sa ma ra tsa ya ma ha bhid kha gha du ya: hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa: ming 'di la mtshon gyis phigs par ma gyur cig: mtshon gyi rtse blta bar ma gyur cig: ma hā badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ rakṣa rakṣa rakṣa: mtshon gyi gnod pa thams cad shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā: 9) mu khyud de yi phyi ma ser po/ la: mtshon gyis tshugs par mi 'gyur ba'i: bden pa'i stobs 'di bri bar bya: dmar po bri mgo phyir bstan 'di dam par bri/ na mo buddha ya na mo dharmā ya na mo saṃ ghā ya sarba ta thā ga ta ga tsa me: na mo sangs rgyas bden pa dang mthu dang gzi brjid kyis ming 'di zhes bya ba la mtshon gyis phigs par ma gyur cig: chos kyi bden pas mtshon zhi bar gyur cig: dge 'dun gyi bden pas mtshon zhi bar= 'khor lo'i rigs kyi bden pas mtshon= rdo rje'i rigs kyi bden pas mtshon= rin chen rigs kyi bden pas mtshon= padma'i rigs kyi= las kyi rigs kyi= sku yi rigs kyi= gsung gi rigs kyi= thugs kyi rigs kyi= zhi ba'i lha'i rigs= khro bo'i rigs kyi lha'i bden pas= theg pa rim par ston pa rnams kyi mthu dang bden pas= bden par smra ba rnams kyi bden pas mtshon zhi bar gyur cig: mtshon gcad do: mtshon brtul lo: mtshon zlog sgyur sa ma ya: sa 'ur sa 'ur: phaṭa phaṭa: rakṣa rakṣa rakṣa: swā hā:

10) mu khyud de yi phyi ma dmar po/ la: mtshon chas mi shigs pa'i sngags: rdo rje sngon po/ drug cu re gcig la: lte bar hūm̐ dang rakṣa bri: rwa la mgo phyir bstan/ hūm̐ gnyis bsnol mar bri: rdo rje'i bar bar sngags 'di bri: oṃ sarba gri ya gri ya mtshon dril rbad chod swā hā: 'khor lo'i rgyab tu rgya gram rdo rje/ dang: oṃ āḥhūm̐: rten 'brel snying po bri: nang gi gru bzhi bang rim brgyad brtsegs/ bang rim bzhi man chad 'khor lo'i rtse mo yar bstan/ rtsibs ser/ mchan dmar/ bzhi man chad rtse mo mar bstan rtsibs dmar mchan sngo/ mdzes byed la tshon byed zer ba'ang 'dug go/ mchod rten la: oṃ mu ni mu ni badzra pā ṇi 'chang ba po la mtshon srungs shig rakṣa: 'khor lo mtshon rtsis kha dog dbye: rdo rjes ma reg padma'i khrag: gtsod khrag sha ba pu shud khrag: gi waṃ gla rtsi kun la byug: khyi dang spre 'us bltar mi rung: mdze yugs nal mas reg mi rung: tshwa dang zwa dang lo ma dang: la phug sgog tsong reg mi rung: sngags la lhag chad med pa dang: mu khyud ma chad ma 'dres dang: shog gu bug rdol med par bya: dang po'i dkyil mig tshal gyis dgag: rab tu gser dngul 'bring du rin chen mtshal: tha ma rgya snag dri bzang ldan pas bri: de ltar 'khor lo legs bris nas: skar ma rgyal la babs pa dang: kha tshar ma nyams ras stengs su: 'bru dang rin chen bcal du bkram: sngags 'go shar bstan 'khor lo bkod: dar zab gur phub rgyal mtshan gzugs: dkar gtor dmar gtor cha lnga bsham: phyi nang mchod gtor gser skyems bsham: shar du gri bdun brdar la bzhag: lho ru mda' bdun gzhu bdungs bzhag: byang du mdung bdun gyen du slong: nub tu sngags pa bdag nyid 'dug: phyi nang yi dam gang mos kyi: mchod bstod legs par gzhung bsrang zhing: lha dang gzhi bdag legs par bcos: de nas gu gul dud pa dang: nyungs dkar rgyal po sngags ldan pas:

'khor lo'i bgegs bskrad bden pa brdar: de nas 'khor lo stong par bsgom: stong pa'i ngang las raṃ byung bas: ye shes me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus: hūm̐ las rdo rje'i rwa gur dang: oṃ las 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa: bhrūm̐ las 'khor lo rtsibs bcu pa: de yi lte bar nyi ma'i steng: khro chu'i rdo rje rtse lnga bsam: sngags kun gser gyi mdog tu bsgom: sngags las 'od zer 'phros pa yis: bskyed pa 'dra ba'i sems dpa' bstim: phyi nang mchod pa tshar gcig dbul: sngags las 'od zer yar 'phros pas: phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi: sku gsung thugs kyi nus pa bkug: 'khor lo'i sngags la yang yang bstim: phyi nang mchod pa tshar gcig dbul: dbus kyi rdo rje gyur pa las: sku yi khro bo gshin rje gshed: smug nag 'khor lo ral gri 'dzin: dur khrod chas kyis brgyan pa yi: thugs kar gsung gi khro bo ni: rta mgrin dmar nag dbang gi sku: dbyug to padma bsnams pa 'o: de yi thugs kar mkha' 'gro ni: bdud rtsi 'khyil ba ljang nag la: rgya gram gtun shing bsnams pa bsgom: de yi thugs kar gos sngon can: mthing nag rdo rje me dpung 'bar: kun kyang 'jigs tshul bstan par bsgom: de yi thugs kar rdo rje yi: lte bar hūm̐ dang sngags 'di bsam: oṃ badzra tsaṇḍa a mṛta ha yaṃ grī ba ya mānta ka hūm̐ hūm̐ hrīḥphaṭa: sngags las 'od byung ye shes bkug: rigs lngas dbang bskur ye shes ldan: sngags las 'od byung bdag la phog: ye shes me yis nyon mongs bsregs: mdun gyi lha tshogs ci 'dra bar: skad cig ma la bdag nyid gyur: dpa' bo yig 'bru nyi shu pa: brgya rtsa brjod la 'bru la bsngags: 'khor lo'i sngags rnams rim bzhin du: brgya rtsa re yis rab gnas bya: bsrung bya thugs ka'i rdo rje yi: lte bar gzi brjid ldan par bzhag: bden pa'i stobs kyis mthun 'gyur bya: de nas bsrung bya khrus nas phyung:

gu gul/ dud pas bdug cing bgegs bskrad la: mtshon gyi bskal pa zhi ba dang: 'gro ba'i 'jigs pa bskyab pa'i phyir: mtshon dbang zhu bar sems bskyed do: khro bo bzhi po bsgom du gzhug: khro bo'i snying po brgya rtsa bzlas: de nas 'khor lo dar gyis dril: mgo mjug ma log spyi bor bzhag: khyad par gzhan las 'phags pa'i chos: 'jam dpal gshin rje gshed po yis: khyed kyi lus kun bsrung bar bya: khro bo'i snying po lan bdun brjod: spyi bor gshin rje gshed po bsgom: de bzhin mgrin par rta mgrin te: snying khar bdud rtsi 'khyil ba las: rgyab tu phyag na rdo rje 'o: gzhan yang 'khor los lus bskor zhing: hūm̐ hūm̐ rakṣa zhes brjod pas: lus kun khro bo mi bzad pa: mthing nag rgya gram bsnams pa yis: khengs par ma yengs dmigs pa gtad: 'bring gis lha bzhi gsal bar bya: tha mas rang lus rdo rje la: ye shes me lnga 'bar bsams la: sngags rgod nyi shu brgya rtsa brgyad: slob dpon lha yi nga rgyal gyis: sha ba gtsod dang spyang ki dang: zhum bu nag po gang rung ba'i: rtug pa gang rnyed chang dang bsres: smra ba gcad la sngags 'di brgya: nyungs dkar la bsngags chang nang du: bskyur ba gdams ngag dam pa yin: oṃ gri ti gri srog la mā ra ya dza: dzaḥrbad rbad gtubs: zi ra thal chen nyungs nag la: brgya bsngags bsgrub bya'i lus la gtor: sngags 'chang bsgrub bya'i lus kun bkru bsang*/ dang: gri mda' mdung gi so la byug: mtshon gyi ngar chag kha nyal nas: mtshon gyi bskal pa nyams bsam ste: bdag dang bsrung bya gnyis ka yis: bden pa'i stobs rnams legs par brjod: bsrung bya'i lha la bka' bsgo bya: bdag dang bsrung bya gnyis ka yis: ma yengs rdo rje'i lte ba na: bsrung bya yod par brtan byas la: 'khor lo mgul nas ma 'chugs par: dpa' po nyi shu lnga brjod cing: rgyab nas mda' bdun brdeg par bya: mdun nas gri bdun brdeg par bya:

g.yas g.yon gnyis nas mda' mdung brdeg: mda' gri mdung sogs grangs 'dzom pas: sngags dang ldan pas brdeg byas la: hūm̐: dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang: skyob pa shākya seng ge yis: mi shigs rdo rje'i ting 'dzin la: rtse gcig bsam gtan gnas mdzad pas: ma rungs bdud kyi mtshon cha rnams: mdzes pa'i me tog rgyan du gyur: bdud kyi sde rigs pham byas nas: mtshon gyi bskal pa nyams par mdzad: de bzhin deng 'dir bu khyod la: sra brtan mtshon cha'i dbang bskur ro: oṃ na ma sarba ghri gri shun tse sha hūm̐ rakṣa rakṣa: zhes pas don snying dbang po dang: lhu tshigs lus kyi gnas kun du: mtshon cha sna tshogs 'debs par bya: de nas bkra shis legs par gsol: rtag tu 'khor lo lus la bcang: lha la gtang rag mchod gtor bya: bdag gi sems dpa' gnas su gshegs: bsgrub bya'i sems dpa' 'khor lo gnas: 'khor lo bde chen zhing du bsam: ji srid 'khor ba gnas kyi bar: 'di la srung zhes phrin las bcol: lo yi dus su 'khor lo la: rab gnas gso ba grub na dga': dge ba bsngo zhing smon lam gdab: bde gshegs rgyal ba 'dus pa yi: 'khor lo'i rgyal po 'di 'chang ba'i: mi la 'khor lo ral gri dang: mda' mdung tri shul st+wa gri dang: lcags sogs rin chen las gyur pa'i: mtshon cha kun gyis tshugs mi 'gyur: thog sogs skar mda' 'bab mi 'gyur: g.yang dang gtib grir 'chor mi 'gyur: rdo gri dbyer ma reg chod kyis: 'di yi lus la mi phigs shing: rtsang dang gtun shing tsher ma yis: 'di yi lus la phigs mi srid: lcags sgrog sdom dang zhags pa yis: 'di yi lus la sdom mi 'gyur: me dang rbod gtong phyogs ngan dang: gshed kyis 'di la tshugs mi 'gyur: dug dang chu ru mi 'gum la: rims dang gza' gdon 'bab mi 'gyur: sde brgyad kun gyis mi mthong zhing: 'go ba'i lha rnams rab tu byams: tshe ring dpal 'byor gzi brjid che:

kun gyis yid du bu bzhin 'ong: bud med rnams la btags gyur na: rtag par mngal du bu pho chags: rgyal ba kun gyis dgongs par mdzad: rtag tu bar chad med par 'gyur: mdze pho yugs sa nal ma yis: mi reg mi 'gom dam tshig ste: de rnams kun la 'dog pa na: 'khor lo gu gul nag pos byug: gnad kyi gdams ngag dam pa 'o: 'di yi rdzas mchog rakta ni: bcu gsum man chad bu mo chu yi khams: mi srid byung yang nus pa yod ma yin: nyer lnga yan chad rgan mo shing gi khams: mi reg srid kyang yid tsam nus pa chung: bcu gsum nyer lnga'i bar gyi lo bcu gsum: gang byung dar ma me lcags dril ba'i khams: nus mthu dpag med rdo rje pha lam rdzas: gang zhig ma rnyed khyim bya'i ze ba dang: khrag dang zer ba'ang 'dug / ga pur bu ram cha mnyam g.yer ma rnams: chang sbyar btang bas don de 'grub par 'gyur: mdog ni dmar ser yid tsam bgrod pa la: rgya sol mer bsregs tsha bzhin 'phar ba dang: mi 'chi gzhom med mchog gi rdzas su bshad: rgyal blon 'khor bcas thugs la 'di dgongs la: da lta mi 'chal spel ba'i gnas med pas: phyi rabs don du rin chen gter du sbos: padma nga yi smon lam mthu btsan pas: las can gcig dang myur du 'di 'phrad shog: phyi rabs rme 'khrug mtshon cha dar ba'i tshe: ti se'i rtse la yul khams mthong rgya che ba'i ri rtse gang yang rung*/ 'khor lo 'di bcangs nas: dge slong brgya yis dmod pa bor gyur na: 'dzam gling 'di ru mtshon 'khrug yong mi srid: ces gsungs pas: rgyal blon bod 'bangs thams cad rab tu dga' ste: gu rus gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do: bde gshegs 'dus pa'i mtshon srung rdo rje'i go cha rdzogs so: rgya gar gyi mkhan po padma 'byung gnas dang: bod kyi lo tsā ba nam mkha'i snying po dang: bai ro tsa nas bsgyur cing zhus te gtan la phab pa'o: ldan ma rtse mang gis yi ger bkod de mnga' bdag la phul lo:

zab rgya: sbas rgya: gtad rgya: gter rgya: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: gu hye: sa ma yā: rgya rgya rgya: shākya'i dge slong rdo rje 'dzin pa tshe brtan rgyal mtshan gyis mon chu phug mo nas bton pa'o/ khyad 'phags shog dril gcig lags so// snod dang mi ldan pa la sa ma ya/ rgya rgya rgya/// /
